description: Toolkit V2 hooks for this project in Codex: Current State at session start; on every message, a line that says to check the project's skills, the text of the owner's rule for every request, and, when the owner uses a keep or decision phrase, a hint on where a fact is filed; a work item reminder after each commit; a work item reminder when a helper agent starts or reports back; and a check of the project's records after each file edit.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"A helper agent ran or was started.
